notes: The Tactician: the bots learned to think. Eight truly distinct opponents, each bringing two surprise picks every match. The bot reads your push and answers it properly -- anti-air against flyers, splash against swarms, its best damage against tanks -- and it refuses bad trades. Real pushes with a tank up front and archers behind. HARD counts your cards: play your biggest card and it knows your hand is weak. Also: Lava Ball is now BOULDER -- same card, new name, still in your deck.
